title: The Walking in after Missing the Start
youtube_title: The Walking in after Missing the Start | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Trying the smallest brave step still counts.
summary: At a bakery counter facing the street, Sora feels shy about walking in after the story had already started. Instead of pretending not to care, Sora tries the smallest brave version in a voice that can be heard, while the ferryman stays kind and does not push for a show.
